errors.text_span: По хоризонталната ос са представени пет различни времеви периоди
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the time periods are on the horizontal axis; they are on the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: като тези категории са разположени в азбучен ред по вертикалната ос
errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted alphabetically; they are sorted in reverse chronological order. This part of the sentence also contradicts the previous statement about which axis holds the categories.
The vertical axis, which displays the time period categories, does not have a label. The description invents a label ('години').

errors.text_span: По вертикалната ос са показани процентни стойности
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the percentage values are on the vertical axis; they are on the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: и са подредени в низходящ ред по височината си
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in descending order of value. While the first bar (2013-2018) is the longest, the subsequent bars are not in descending order (21%, 17%, 18%, 16%).

errors.text_span: визуално оценени по скалата на вертикалната ос
errors.evidence: The scale for evaluating the values is on the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.
